notes: Equivalent loop counts, algorithms, retained data and checksum outputs; syntax/API spellings differ.
Integers remain exactly representable in DotK 2's numeric representation; no IO inside timed loops except identical GC calls.
Explicit matching GC checkpoints prevent DotK 3's bounded managed heap from failing; this is controlled GC behavior, not a comparison of default GC policies.
All time measurements include process launch, parsing/compilation, core initialization, workload execution and shutdown; startup is reported separately, not subtracted.
Peak RSS and macOS peak physical footprint are separate per-process high-water marks, not live managed heap or incremental allocation counts.
Binary footprint excludes separately installed system dynamic libraries and optional native modules; dependencies and stripped copies are recorded.

workloads.name: startup
workloads.description: Initialize the runtime and print one integer; warm-cache process startup baseline.

workloads.name: arithmetic
workloads.description: 100000 loop iterations with integer multiply/add/modulo and accumulation.
workloads.dotkv2:
var total = 0
var index = 0
while (index < 100000) { total += (index * 17 + 3) % 1009; index += 1; }
print(total)
workloads.dotkv3:
var total = 0
var index = 0
while index < 100000 { total += (index * 17 + 3) % 1009; index += 1; }
System.print(total)

workloads.name: recursive_fib

workloads.name: list_live
workloads.description: Append and retain20000 integers then read/index/sum them.
workloads.dotkv3:
var values: List<Int> = []
var index = 0
while index < 20000 { values.append(index % 97); index += 1;  }
var total = 0
index = 0
while index < 20000 { total += values[index]; index += 1;  }
System.print(total)

workloads.name: map_live
workloads.description: Insert and retain2000 integer keys/values then look up/sum all keys.

workloads.name: string_split
workloads.description: Split the same ASCII string into8 parts6000 times, query lengths/find, and collect every100 iterations.
workloads.dotkv2:
var text = 'alpha,beta,gamma,delta,epsilon,zeta,eta,theta'
var total = 0
var index = 0
while (index < 6000) { var parts = text.split(','); total += len(parts) + len(parts[4]) + parts[3].find('t'); index += 1;  }
print(total)
workloads.dotkv3:
var text = 'alpha,beta,gamma,delta,epsilon,zeta,eta,theta'
var total = 0
var index = 0
while index < 6000 { var parts = text.split(','); total += parts.length() + parts[4].length() + parts[3].find('t'); index += 1;  }
System.print(total)
